title: HELIX Bridge (Reverse): HELIX Student → Banner SaaS (Ethos)
write_model: PUT/POST /api/students keyed by person GUID where supported. In many tenants the student record is established through admissions/registration business processes rather than a direct write; treat direct write as best-effort with fallback to process APIs.

attribute_mappings.transformation: External crosswalk to students GUID. Do not write helix_id.
Resolve the person's Ethos GUID from the crosswalk; students references persons by GUID.
attribute_mappings.notes: Person must exist in Ethos before the student record can be created.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Map helix/student-type to tenant student-types GUID.
attribute_mappings.notes: FLAG: 'students' resource in Ethos is comparatively thin; much student context lives in student-academic-programs. Verify field availability per API version.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Student status transitions are typically driven by registration/academic-program events, not a direct writable field.
attribute_mappings.notes: Prefer student-academic-programs + section-registrations to establish effective status.

constraints: The Ethos 'students' resource is minimal; most student lifecycle state derives from student-academic-programs and section-registrations.
person GUID must pre-exist (create Person first).
Some tenants do not permit direct POST to students; the student is materialized as a side effect of program/admission processes — verify tenant capability.
